questions.question: Which actor plays Mutt Williams in Kingdom of the Crystal Skull?
questions.note: LaBeouf plays Mutt, the leather-jacketed young man later revealed to be Indy and Marion’s son.

questions.question: In Kingdom of the Crystal Skull, what does Indy hide in during a nuclear test?
questions.note: Area 51, 1957. The warehouse from the end of Raiders is next door.

questions.question: In Kingdom of the Crystal Skull, how is Mutt Williams related to Indy?
questions.note: Marion is the mother. They kept that quiet for decades.

questions.question: At the end of Kingdom of the Crystal Skull, what do Indy and Marion finally do?
questions.note: Same Marion from Raiders. The fedora even finds Mutt for a second.

questions.question: Who directed Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny, the first Indy film Spielberg did not direct?
questions.note: Mangold made Logan and Ford v Ferrari. Spielberg and Lucas stayed on as producers.

questions.question: Dial of Destiny is set mainly in which year, around the Apollo 11 moon landing?
questions.note: Ford’s Indy is about to retire from teaching. The opening is a de-aged wartime prologue.

questions.question: Which actor plays former Nazi scientist Jürgen Voller in Dial of Destiny?
questions.note: Mikkelsen’s Voller wants Archimedes’ Dial so he can change the outcome of World War II.

questions.question: Which actor plays Soviet agent Irina Spalko in Kingdom of the Crystal Skull?
questions.note: Blanchett plays the sword-wielding Soviet psychic who pursues the crystal skull.

questions.question: What ancient device is the MacGuffin in Dial of Destiny?
questions.note: Also called the Antikythera. It can find fissures in time. Indy is tired of magic rocks by now.

questions.question: What is Indiana Jones’s full name?
questions.note: Indiana is the nickname he takes from the family dog. His legal name is Henry Walton Jones Jr.
